class Solution:

        stack = []
        for token in re.split('(\d+|\[|\])', s):
            if token.isdigit():
                stack.append(int(token))
            elif token == '[':

            elif token == ']':
                num = stack.pop()
                string = stack.pop()
                stack.append(string * num)
            else:
                stack.append(token)
        return ''.join(stack)
